headline: Mirror Force
title: Mirror Force Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Mirror Force. What is it? It is a Normal Trap Card. What does it do? When your opponent's monster declares an attack, destroy all of your opponent's Attack Position monsters. How do you use it? Set it and wait for an attack. The more monsters in Attack Position, the bigger the punish. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
